# simply_products (Data Source)

Lists Simply.com products available to the configured account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simply_products" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `products` (Attributes List) Products available to the configured account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the product has been cancelled.
- `domain` (Attributes) Domain information for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--domain))
- `name` (String) Product name or handle.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Simply.com nameservers currently assigned to the domain in Simply.com's system. This does not query the registry.
- `object` (String) Product identifier to use in other Simply API calls.
- `object_uri` (String) Product object URI.
- `service` (Attributes) Service information for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--service))

<a id="nestedatt--products--domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.domain`

Read-Only:

- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the domain is registered and managed by Simply.com.
- `name` (String) ASCII domain name.
- `name_idn` (String) Internationalized domain name.
- `renew_date` (String) Next renewal date for the domain, if available.


<a id="nestedatt--products--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.service`

Read-Only:

- `created_date` (String) Product creation date.
- `expire_date` (String) Product expiration date, if available.
- `id` (Number) Service ID.
- `name` (String) Service name.
